OpenAsync transfers its owned stream to DatabaseFile/PageFile; OpenCoreAsync closes it on failure and AccessReader disposal closes it on success. The reported line 16707566 is a hidden async sequence point.

userTables is a volatile reference publishing complete immutable snapshots. Reader invalidation happens after operation leases drain during disposal; writer reads and invalidation share mutationGate serialization. Reader and writer own separate catalogs.

DatabaseFile owns Pages; successful construction transfers cleanup to the outer reader/writer, whose normal disposal and failed outer construction dispose Pages. PageFile closes IoGate and Pager closes frameGate. After Pages assignment the constructor only allocates caches; public writer construction validates the cache size first.
